# Sushi Den — Vancouver

> A casual Japanese restaurant at 609 Abbott St, near Stadium–Chinatown SkyTrain Station in Vancouver, British Columbia.

- [Home](https://mapal-27.github.io/Website/): Takeout phone, menu favorites, Why Us, Google reviews link, hours, and directions.
- [Menu highlights](https://mapal-27.github.io/Website/menu.html): Selected rolls, combos, and house specials with sample prices in Canadian dollars.

## Business details

- Name: Sushi Den.
- Address: 609 Abbott St, Vancouver, BC V6B 0J4, Canada.
- Phone: +1 604-687-4422. Call for takeout, reservations, and pickup timing.
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 11:00–22:00; Sundays and holidays 12:00–22:00, local Vancouver time.
- Positioning: Casual neighborhood sushi, generous portions, convenient takeout near the SkyTrain.
- Vegetarian options are available; ask the restaurant about gluten-free alternatives and preparation.

## Menu highlights

Sample prices in CAD, not live quotes: California Roll $4.50; Dynamite Roll $5.50; Spicy Salmon Roll $4.00; Yam Roll $6.00; Roll & Nigiri Combo $19.50; Sashimi & Roll Combo $15.00; Dinner for Two Combo $28.00. Red Dragon Roll price is not supplied. Call to confirm current prices, ingredients, availability, and the full menu.

## Sources and limitations

Business information and menu highlights were supplied by the site owner on October 23, 2026; they were not independently checked against the restaurant's website because research access was blocked. Food images are AI-generated illustrations. No review rating, customer quotation, guaranteed ten-minute pickup, or complimentary tea/soup offer is asserted. No online checkout or reservation system is connected. Read reviews and listing updates on Google.
